# Cyberinfrastructure Fundamentals:
*Supporting Resilience and Security in the Hawai`i-Pacific Region*

### A short course on cyberinfrastructure and its role in addressing sustainability challenges in the Pacific region

::: {.hero-buttons}
[Get Started → Sign Up Today](https://webforms.chaminade.edu/dataskills_short_courses/){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}

## What is this course about?

Pacific Islands are on the front lines of climate change with rising sea levels, intensifying typhoons, and shrinking freshwater supplies that threaten communities across the region. To address these challenges, what tools, resources, and data exist? 

This course introduces **cyberinfrastructure**, the hardware, software, data systems, networks, and human capacity that power modern research, and explores how it can be leveraged for sustainability decision-making in Small Island Developing States (SIDS) and the Pacific region.

For this course, there is no coding experience required.


## Course Outline
::: {.course-outline}

| Week | Topic | Content | Due |
|------|-------|---------|-----|
| Week 1 | [Getting Started](week1.qmd) | CI Foundations and Course Introduction | Sunday, End of Week 1 |
| Week 2 | [Pacific Context and CI Tools](week2.qmd) | Pacific Introduction and Tools Overview | Sunday, End of Week 2 |
| Week 3 | [Accessing CI and How It Works](week3.qmd) | NSF Resources and Cloud/HPC Infrastructure | Sunday, End of Week 3 |
| Week 4 | [From Data to Decisions](week4.qmd) | Translating CI Outputs Into Sustainability Policy | Sunday, End of Week 4 |
| Weeks 5-6 | [Final Project](project.qmd) | Drafting and Finalizing the Policy Brief | Sunday, End of Week 6 |

:::
